test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

He applied for official ______ to organise the event.
solution:
The correct answer is:** 'Permission'.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• ** **​The given sentence is talking about** someone takes official permission to organise the event.**​ 
 
• **​**​The word '**Permission'** here means **the act of allowing somebody to do something, especially when this is done by somebody in a position of authority.**
 
 
• **For example** - The teacher gave me her** permission **to go home early.
 
 

 Therefore, **permission** is the correct word to fill in.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us explore the other given options:
 
• **Agreement -** the state of agreeing with somebody/something.
 
• **Provision - **the giving or supplying of something to somebody or making something available for somebody to use.
 
• **Authority -** the power and right to give orders and make others obey.

 

**​**
